bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
existing=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts WHERE title='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト' AND created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours'")
test "$existing" = 0 || exit 71
draft=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='room' AND data->>'title'='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト'")
echo TEST_ROOM_DRAFT_COUNT="$draft"
test "$draft" = 1 || exit 72
echo ROOM_PUBLIC_TEST_STALE_PRIVATE_DRAFT_CONFIRMED
